errors.text_span: Лентите са в различни нюанси на синьо/сиво (по-светли към долните категории)
errors.evidence: The description over-generalizes the color scheme by describing it as 'different shades...lighter towards the bottom categories', which implies a gradient. The chart actually uses two distinct colors: the top four bars are a dark teal, and the bottom three bars are a lighter, greyish-blue, creating two visual groups.
